The 108 number is symbolic (the 108 worldly defilements in Buddhist teaching). Skip option: stay at the upper viewing area, which gives a strong photo of the temple from above without the descent.

/staticQuestions/5/answer.source_en: Moderate to challenging — the alleys are steep, narrow, and stair-heavy. Wear shoes with grip; take it slow and use the stair handrails. Typical local choices when you do stop: dwaeji-gukbap (Busan pork-bone soup) or milmyeon (cold wheat noodles, the city's signature Korean War refugee dish). Vegetarian / halal options possible with advance notice.
